description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline IPC component, specifically testing the handling of media data events and IPC communication success/failure scenarios. It defines a test class 'RialtoClientMediaPipelineIpcDataTest' with setup and teardown methods, and multiple test cases verifying event forwarding, session ID validation, and IPC call behaviors.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineIpcDataTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the MediaPipeline IPC data handling, including event forwarding and IPC communication robustness.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates the media pipeline IPC, and initializes shared memory info.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, destroys the media pipeline IPC.

methods.name: initShmInfo
methods.description: Initializes the shared memory info structure with predefined values.

methods.name: createNeedDataEvent
methods.description: Creates a NeedMediaDataEvent with optional shared memory info.
